The fastest Mac form of the speed comparison (e8cl, int8 in layers 0-7) is not published and has no record. quantization: text decoder: every fully connected weight fp16 (float_casting), no activation type declared (the GPU runs float16 activations by default); token embedding table int8 (dynamic_wi8_afp32, externalized); vision encoder fp32 + adapter fp16 weights, both declared fp32 activations; fast_vlm, pictures 512 x 512 (256 tokens), KV cache 2048
